name: Solitaire Battle
detailed_description:
Solitaire Battle is a roguelike deckbuilder on a solitaire board where the cards you pick up let you attack, synergize, and slay fantastical opponents!

Pick up and draw cards to trigger your attacks and abilities, build decks with wild synergies, and face enemies who make you play solitaire in unique and strategic ways! As you gather skills, every card pickup will start a chain of effects that attack, power you up, and weaken your enemies.

Choose your hero and face those who would use solitaire for evil!  Play as a dwarf who digs up cards to stun opponents, a knight who fills the board with shields to defend himself, or a monk who waits for the right moment to unleash a ceaseless combo of attacks! Defeat powerful bosses, like an immortal lich, a fearsome dragon, or… an unexpectedly dangerous chicken.

Wishlist and follow to be updated when Solitaire Battle releases!

Gameplay:

  • Classic tri-peaks solitaire gameplay with a roguelike deckbuilding twist. Pick up, draw, and discard cards to strategically defeat your opponents

  • Upgrade your deck at the shop after every battle to get strong enough to break the game

  • Discover new synergies and builds every playthrough from a variety of weapons, skills, and passive items

  • Clever enemies and bosses will fight back with their own attacks and harmful status effects

  • Defeat the final boss to gain treasures that unlock new playable heroes and difficulty levels

  • Still not done!? Continue after winning on an increased difficulty to reach a state of solitaire flow and put your build to the test against the ultimate opponents

Features:

  • An interactive tutorial on how to play solitaire

  • 14 heroes to play as, or to face in battle

  • Over 60 weapons, skills, and passive items to master

  • 25 bosses to defeat

  • 12 rounds of solitaire to battle across, plus a post-game endless mode

  • 10 solitaire battlefields to fight on

  • 4+ difficulty levels to conquer

  • More than 75 treasures to achieve and use to unlock new heroes and difficulties

  • A looping post-game that continues until defeat

  • Wishlist the game to be updated on release!
